method: Independent text review of all eight unchanged development references and predeclared criteria against exact raw output. No candidate tuning, re-recognition, fresh heldout exposure, transcript repair or audio listening. Source/criteria snapshot was retained before candidate outputs were inspected.
scope: Exposed development recognizer-only feasibility screen, not app integration or a matched model-only comparison.

classification_definitions.acceptable: No material content error observed; accepted punctuation, contraction or spelling conventions may differ.
classification_definitions.minor_issue: A limited word, spelling, grammar or precision problem needs correction while the central proposition remains recoverable.
classification_definitions.major_error: A proper name, proposition, semantic relationship or substantial content is incorrectly recognized.
classification_definitions.not_evaluable: No completed aligned transcript is available.

technical_result.input_conversion_note: The predeclared faster-whisper audio preparation converts original float32 WAV samples through signed-16-bit PCM. Independent audit verifies the entire expected converted array sample-for-sample and its exact logged frontend hash; it does not incorrectly claim unchanged source float32 payload bytes.
technical_result.timestamp_scope: Observed token emission positions at 80 ms granularity, not independently verified word boundaries or word end times.
technical_result.resource_scope: Owned worker recorded peak RSS plus sampled owned process-group RSS, not a whole-machine or unseen group-peak claim.

cases.reference: Κάποια φεστιβάλ παρέχουν ειδικούς κατασκηνωτικούς χώρους για οικογένειες με μικρά παιδιά.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the provision of special family camping areas and the reference to young children.
cases.hypothesis: Κάποια φεστιβάλ παρέχουν ειδικού κατασκημού χώρου για οικογένει με μικρά παιδιά.
cases.reason: Festivals providing special camping areas for families with young children remains recoverable. However, ειδικούς κατασκηνωτικούς χώρους becomes the malformed ειδικού κατασκημού χώρου, and οικογένειες becomes incomplete οικογένει. These are substantive spelling and agreement defects requiring editing, rather than acceptable punctuation variations.

comparison.small_vad_off_completed_hypothesis: Κάποια φεστιβάλ παρέχουν ιδικούς κατασκοινωτικούς χώρους για οικογένεις με μικρά παιδιά.
comparison.turbo_completed_hypothesis: Κάποια φεστιβάλ παρέχουν ειδικούς κατασκηνοτικούς χώρους για οικογένειες με μικρά παιδιά.
comparison.interpretation: Small already has spelling errors (ιδικούς κατασκοινωτικούς, οικογένεις); Turbo has κατασκηνοτικούς. Parakeet introduces more damaged word endings and an incomplete family noun. None of that establishes a new semantic improvement.

cases.reference: Είναι το πέμπτο προσωρινό εκλογικό συμβούλιο του Μαρτελί μέσα σε τέσσερα χρόνια.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the fifth council, the four-year interval and the proper name Μαρτελί. Written-out versus numeric forms may be equivalent.
cases.hypothesis: Είναι το πέμπτο προσωρινό εκλογικό συμβούριο του Μαρτέι μέσα σε τέσσερα χρόνια.
cases.reason: The proper name Μαρτελί becomes Μαρτέι, so the original identification criterion fails. The council word also changes to malformed συμβούριο. Fifth and four years are correctly preserved; this is not a numerical failure.

comparison.small_vad_off_completed_hypothesis: Είναι το πέμπτο προσωρινό εκλογικό συμβούλιο του Μαρτεή μέσα σε 4 χρόνια.
comparison.turbo_completed_hypothesis: Είναι το 5ο προσωρινό εκλογικό συμβούλιο του Μαρτεΐ μέσα σε 4 χρόνια.
comparison.interpretation: Small has Μαρτεή and Turbo Μαρτεΐ; all three fail the original proper-name requirement while preserving the numbers. Parakeet additionally degrades συμβούλιο.

cases.reference: Αυτό δεν μου βγάζει νόημα. Σε κάθε περίπτωση δεν ήταν δίκαιο.
original_review_criteria: Both negative statements must survive: it does not make sense, and in any case it was not fair.
cases.hypothesis: Αυτό δεν μου βγάζει νόημα, σε κάθε περίπτωση δεν ήταν.
cases.reason: The first negation is intact, but the second clause ends σε κάθε περίπτωση δεν ήταν. The missing δίκαιο removes the predicate fair/right and leaves an unfinished proposition. The negative particle is still present; this is content omission, not a claim that the model inverted the negation.

comparison.small_vad_off_completed_hypothesis: Αυτό δεν μου βγάζει νόημα. Σε κάθε περίπτωση δεν ήταν δίκιο.
comparison.turbo_completed_hypothesis: Αυτό δεν μου βγάζει νόημα. Σε κάθε περίπτωση δεν ήταν δίκαιο.
comparison.interpretation: This is a concrete new loss against both completed comparisons. Small says δεν ήταν δίκιο, which retains the nearby not-right sense; Turbo exactly retains δεν ήταν δίκαιο. Parakeet loses the final content word entirely.

cases.reference: Μολονότι 3 άνθρωποι βρίσκονταν μέσα στο σπίτι κατά την πρόσκρουση του αυτοκινήτου, δεν τραυματίστηκε κανείς.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the count of three people and the claim that nobody was injured despite the collision.
cases.hypothesis: Μόλι άνθρωποι βρίσκονταν μέσα στο σπίτι κατά την πρόσκληση του αυτοκίνητο, δεν τραυματίστηκαν.
cases.reason: The count three is absent. Μολονότι is replaced by incomplete Μόλι, losing the although relationship; πρόσκρουση (collision) becomes πρόσκληση (invitation). The ending δεν τραυματίστηκαν still says they were not injured. The explicit κανείς is absent, but no clean positive/negative reversal is alleged; the missing count and wrong collision/concession already decisively fail the criterion.

comparison.small_vad_off_completed_hypothesis: Μόνο ότι τρεις άνθρωποι βρίσκονταν μέσα στο σπίτι κατά την πρόσκληση του αυτοκινήτου δεν τραγματίσκε κανείς.
comparison.turbo_completed_hypothesis: Μολονότι τρεις άνθρωποι βρίσκονταν μέσα στο σπίτι κατά την πρόσκουση του αυτοκινήτου δεν τραυματίσκε κανείς.
comparison.interpretation: Both completed Small and Turbo retain τρεις and δεν ... κανείς. Small already wrongly says πρόσκληση and damages the concession; Turbo retains the concession and a recognizable, imperfect collision word πρόσκουση. Parakeet adds loss of the count and changes the final scope/wording.

cases.reference: Η κύρια τοπική μπίρα ονομάζεται «Number One» και δεν αποτελεί μια σύνθετη μπύρα, είναι όμως ευχάριστη και δροσιστική. Η άλλη τοπική μπίρα λέγεται «Manta».
original_review_criteria: Preserve the two product names Number One and Manta and the negated description of the first beer.
cases.hypothesis: Η κύρια τοπική πύρα ονομάζεται Number One, και δεν αποτελεί μια σύνθενη πύρα, είναι όμω ευχάριστη και δροσητική. Η άλλη τοπική μπείρα λέγεται Μάντα.
cases.reason: Number One and Μάντα preserve the two product names; Μάντα is an acceptable Greek rendering of Manta. The negative complexity description and positive pleasant/refreshing comparison remain recoverable, but πύρα is an incorrect rendering of beer, σύνθενη is malformed, and όμω, δροσητική and μπείρα require correction. This is classified as a recoverable but visibly defective proposition, not clean or publication-ready Greek.

comparison.small_vad_off_completed_hypothesis: Η κύριε τοπική μπήρα ονομάζεται number one και δεν αποτελεί μια σύνθετη μπήρα. Είναι όμως ευχάριστο και δροσητική. Η άλλη τοπική μπήρα λέγεται μάντα.
comparison.turbo_completed_hypothesis: Η κύρια τοπική μπύρα ονομάζεται Number One και δεν αποτελεί μια σύνθετη μπύρα, είναι όμως ευχάριστη και δροσεκτική. Η άλλη τοπική μπύρα λέγεται Manda.
comparison.interpretation: Small likewise retains number one/μάντα with multiple spelling/agreement errors. Turbo retains Number One but spells the second name Manda and uses δροσεκτική. Parakeet improves neither overall Greek accuracy nor the need for careful editing; its first beer noun is additionally damaged.

cases.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the distant phone-call condition and satellite claim as spoken; this is transcription fidelity, not fact checking.
cases.hypothesis: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you're using a satellite.
cases.reason: The distant-call condition, thousands of miles and satellite claim are all preserved. You are becomes the equivalent contraction you're. This assesses source fidelity and does not fact-check the spoken satellite claim.

comparison.small_vad_off_completed_hypothesis: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
comparison.turbo_completed_hypothesis: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away you're using a satellite
comparison.interpretation: Small matches the reference wording and Turbo uses the same contraction as Parakeet. All preserve the proposition; contraction/punctuation differences are not semantic improvements or regressions.

cases.reference: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the U.N. attribution, proposed fund, affected countries and intended help in coping with warming impacts.
cases.hypothesis: The UN also hopes to finalise a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
cases.reason: U.N. attribution, hope to finalize a fund, affected countries and help coping with warming impacts are all preserved. UN and finalise are acceptable punctuation/spelling variants.

comparison.small_vad_off_completed_hypothesis: The UN also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
comparison.turbo_completed_hypothesis: The UN also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
comparison.interpretation: Both completed comparisons preserve the same full proposition. Parakeet uses British finalise instead of finalize; no meaning difference is observed.

cases.reference: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the person name Lakkha Singh, leading role and the sung bhajans.
cases.hypothesis: Then Laka Singh took the lead in singing the Bajans.
cases.reason: The leading role/action is correctly expressed, but Lakkha Singh is written Laka Singh and bhajans is written Bajans. The original identity and music-term requirements are not met. The sentence is substantially clearer than the prior outputs, but the remaining named-entity/term errors prevent an acceptable classification.

comparison.small_vad_off_completed_hypothesis: Then Lakas sing to the lead and singing the basjams
comparison.turbo_completed_hypothesis: Then Laka sing to the lead and singing the pashams.
comparison.interpretation: Small says Lakas sing to the lead and singing the basjams; Turbo says Laka sing to the lead and singing the pashams. Parakeet restores Singh and took the lead in, a real local improvement, while the given-name spelling and bhajans term still fail.

material_findings: Fairness predicate is newly omitted relative to both completed Small and Turbo outputs.
Collision case loses the count of three and the concessive relationship, and wrongly renders collision as invitation. The negative injury statement itself remains.
Μαρτελί is still damaged. The English Lakkha Singh/bhajans case improves action grammar but retains identity/term errors.
Other Greek outputs have multiple correctable spelling/agreement/content-word defects; two ordinary English clips preserve their full propositions.
comparison_limits: The original failed Small SOCKS report supplies no usable recognition hypotheses and is retained only as failure context.
Actual completed Small and Turbo runs used explicit source-language selection and the application upload route. This prototype supplies no language hint and exercises only the recognizer.
Differences cannot be causally attributed solely to the model family or quantization, and elapsed times are not a controlled matched benchmark.
These eight short read-speech clips do not establish long-recording completeness, silence behavior, Auto-language accuracy in general, or noisy/conversational speech performance.

audit_preparation_correction.note: An initial reviewer-only byte-equality assertion was corrected to the already documented signed-16-bit decode conversion. The failed assertion and initial checker are preserved; candidate/source/criteria/output bytes and the one-attempt screen remain unchanged.

decision: Reject this exact candidate for production adoption or a justified full-film follow-up. Modest-resource execution is demonstrated on these eight short clips, but semantic acceptance fails. Keep raw successes, losses and technical measurements; do not treat structural passes as quality approval.
